title: tc-document-list
description:
Identity and record documents with masked numbers, expiry and a status each – Active, Verified, Expired, Flagged,
Fraudulent or your own – counted in the header, with View per row.

statuses.description: Statuses' names and tones, merged over the defaults (verified, active, expired, flagged, fraudulent)

masked.description: Masks numbers to their last four characters until revealed; set false to show them in full

revealed.description: The ids whose numbers are shown. Changed by the user unless a tc-revealed-change listener calls preventDefault()

locale.description: The language for expiry dates, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

number.description: The document's number; masked to its last four characters unless `masked` is off or it's revealed

reference.description: Your own reference for the record, e.g. an evidence or file id

expires.description: When it expires, as epoch ms

status.description: A key of `statusLabels`: active, verified, expired, flagged, fraudulent, or one of the page's own

note.description: One quiet line: "Expiry date doesn't match the issuing record"

DocumentTone.description: The tone a status is drawn in
